description_full: RLX Technology Inc., through its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells e-vapor products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It offers rechargeable e-vapor products under the Qingyu, Phantom, Phantom Pro, Zeus, Leili, and Daqian names; and disposable e-vapor products under the Feiliu and Feiliu Mega names. The company also provides closed-system rechargeable products, open-system products, closed-system disposable products, and modern oral products. It sells its products through local channels, third-party distribution channels, and distribution channels co-managed with third parties, as well as online and offline end users. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.

financial_summary: RLX Technology Inc. is a small-cap consumer defensive business with a $1.9B market cap on $594M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -11% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 3% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 35%.

The business throws off $148M in free cash flow — roughly 25 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.20× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 51× is fortress-like.

Shareholder yield of 2.2% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 89% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
